claims.meaning: Public MHS preview material supports standardized device discovery/state/read-write/orchestration and declared device characteristics/safety limits; Universal Robots separately keeps underlying robot safety architecture in charge.
allowedWording: MHS standardizes an agent-facing hardware integration layer
declared MHS bounds do not replace every underlying machine safety mechanism
avoid: MHS replaces certified robot safety systems

claims.meaning: The Genentech foaming episode shows that an operable interface and runtime feedback can coexist with an incorrect physical diagnosis; expert physical interpretation changed the corrective action.
allowedWording: successful device access does not establish correct physical-state interpretation

claims.meaning: NIST guidance treats metrological traceability as a property of a particular measurement result and states that traceability alone does not guarantee fitness for purpose; instrument identity/calibration alone is insufficient.
allowedWording: device readability is not itself measurement adequacy
traceability belongs to results, not instruments in the abstract
avoid: every agent measurement requires NIST calibration

claims.meaning: The QuEra public case used independent phase-noise analysis and long-horizon lock behavior to check agent-derived settings; NASA V&V supplies a mature engineering analogue for separating conformance evidence from intended-use validation.
allowedWording: operation or proxy success need not settle the stronger result/use claim
verification and intended-use validation are distinct engineering questions
avoid: one validation pattern is universal across science
the MHS interface owns result admission

claims.meaning: A scoped synthesis of the cited cases separates agent-hardware operability, native safety, physical diagnosis, measurement adequacy and result/use admission. The separation is a review heuristic, not a required five-service architecture.
allowedWording: ask which boundary has actually been established
the five questions may have different evidence owners
avoid: the five boundaries are an MHS specification
this is a universal ontology of physical AI
